description: This file contains server-side logic for the TheorySet page of an online examination system. It manages course selection, question and exam setup, and navigation between administrative pages. It interacts with a SQL Server database to insert and retrieve question and course detail data.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: A partial class representing the server-side code of the TheorySet ASP.NET page, handling page load, navigation, course selection, question addition, and exam setup.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load of the web page, currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new question to the 'theoryQS' database table and updates the question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Inserts exam details into the 'theoryCourseDetail' table and navigates to the admin panel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Refills the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course by counting existing questions in the database.
